ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels constitute approximately 85% of the visible surface, with low-intensity black pixels concentrated on the perimeter and focal points forming a distinct high-contrast boundary.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous black pigmentation band along the entire trailing edge and tips; dense black mottling at the left distal tip; scattered circular black spots (2-8 pixels) in both lobe quadrants; bilateral yellowish-tan pigmentation clusters adjacent to the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 42 degrees; notch depth occupies 15% of the vertical fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-amplitude, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys of 3-6 pixels) on the distal half of the right lobe; low-frequency scalloping on the left lobe; smooth linear boundary approaching the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge lobes exhibit a moderate concave curvature from notch to tip, terminating in acute points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple circular dark-pixel clusters (rosettes) across both lobes; white calcified circular nodes (barnacles) visible at the extreme distal tips and along the right trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark-pixel linear disruptions (rake marks) crossing the lower-central region and extending diagonally across the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple linear rake marks crossing the central fluke region; barnacle colonization at the distal tips and right trailing edge margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Symmetrical yellowish-brown bio-staining concentrated at the proximal base of the fluke lobes near the peduncle junction.
